name: Little My Maid
source:
You are Kenji Kamogawa, age 19. You were one of the brightest students in high school, considered by your teachers and parents to be a shoo-in for the best four-year universities. Unfortunately, your dreams of university came crashing to an end when you failed your entrance exams -- and lost your beloved Yukari at the same time.

Time has passed. You're enrolled in a cram school where you study for next year's college entrance exams, but you're unable to concentrate on your studies, so devastated are you by your break-up with Yukari. Ashamed of your lot, you wander to the seaside, where you enjoyed fun memories of your last summer with your lover.

Suddenly, you hear a sweet voice, crying out for help. It's a beautiful woman -- a young maid-in-training -- about to be subjected to a terrible fate at the hands of a band of hoodlums. Thinking fast, you are able to save her life.

"My name is Mari," she says, through her tears. "I work as a maid at a nearby mansion. Please...let me repay your kindness."

She takes you to her Mistress' mansion, Sea Dragon Mansion, which overlooks the mist-shrouded seaside. There you encounter her two sisters, also maids-in-training: the proud and capable Hina and the delightfully cute Mayu-chan. You also meet the mysterious mistress of the mansion, Hime, and the cold trainer-of-maids, Aya.

Welcomed as a guest, you choose to stay for a time in Sea Dragon Mansion. Aya coldly explains the rules of the house to you: you are the guest, and that means that the three maids will strive for your every pleasure. Ring one of the three bells to call any one of the three maids, and they will come and serve you in any way you please.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20140909000744/http://www.peachprincess.com/little-my-maid.html]Peach Princess[/url]]
translation:
你是贺川健二，19岁。你曾是高中里最优秀的学生之一，被老师和父母视为名牌大学的不二人选。不幸的是，你的大学梦在入学考试落榜的同时崩塌了——你也同时失去了心爱的香。

时光流逝。你进入了一所补习学校，为明年的大学入学考试做准备，但你无法集中精力学习，因为与香的分手让你心碎不已。为自己的处境感到羞愧，你漫步到了海边——那里留有你和恋人最后一个夏天的快乐回忆。

突然，你听到一个甜美的声音在呼救。那是一位美丽的女性——一位年轻的女仆学徒——即将落入一群流氓的魔掌。你反应迅速，救了她的命。

“我叫玛莉，”她含着泪说道。“我在附近的一座宅邸当女仆。请……让我报答您的恩情。”

她带你来到了她主人的宅邸——海龙庄，俯瞰着雾气弥漫的海滨。在那里你遇到了她的两位同样在实习的姐妹：骄傲能干的日奈和可爱迷人的真由酱。你还遇到了宅邸神秘的女主人姬，以及冷酷的女仆训练师绫。

作为客人受到欢迎，你选择在海龙庄住上一段时间。绫冷冷地向你说明了宅邸的规矩：你是客人，这意味着三位女仆将竭力满足你的一切享受。摇响三个铃铛中的任何一个，就能召唤对应的女仆，她们会以任何你希望的方式前来侍奉你。

[引自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20140909000744/http://www.peachprincess.com/little-my-maid.html]Peach Princess[/url]]
